verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships multiple official, documented SDKs for AI-native/agentic workflows: the core Engine (npm-published, versioned), @playcanvas/react and @playcanvas/web-components declarative SDKs with dedicated llms.txt docs, a scriptable Editor API, an official create-playcanvas scaffolding tool, and a dedicated official MCP server for Editor automation plus AI 'Skills' for coding agents—corroborated by npm/GitHub runtime probes. missing for 10: independent third-party developer testimonials specifically about building AI agents against these SDKs, and a fully documented OpenAPI/REST spec (probe found only 404s for OpenAPI endpoints).
